summary: Builds multi-stop delivery routes for the day's manifest and re-optimizes them mid-shift when new orders drop in, minimizing total drive time across the fleet.
Solves large vehicle-routing problems overnight for the next day's dispatch, balancing stop counts evenly across available drivers and vehicle capacities.
Watches live traffic and driver progress and suggests route reshuffles when a delay threatens on-time delivery windows further down the route.
Gives planners a quick mileage and fuel-cost estimate for a proposed route before it's committed to dispatch, helping compare route options side by side.
Distributes the day's stops across multiple depots to keep each facility's outbound volume within its loading dock capacity.
Shows dispatchers a live map of every vehicle's position and status, letting them spot a stalled truck or an off-route driver at a glance.
The core GPS ingestion console that logs vehicle telemetry from onboard units and exposes it to downstream routing and analytics tools.
Fires alerts when a vehicle enters or leaves a defined geofence, used to confirm arrival at a customer site or flag an unauthorized detour.
Flags excessive engine idling and unusual fuel consumption per vehicle, helping fleet managers coach drivers and cut fuel spend.
Streams engine fault codes and diagnostic trouble codes from each vehicle into a single feed so maintenance can triage issues before a breakdown occurs.
Recommends where each SKU should be slotted in the warehouse based on pick frequency, cutting travel distance for the picking team.
Groups outbound orders into picking waves and sequences each picker's path to minimize backtracking across the warehouse floor.
Coordinates freight that moves straight from inbound trailer to outbound trailer without ever touching a storage shelf, tracking dock-to-dock timing.
Keeps a live record of which bin holds which pallet or case, reconciled against scans at every move so lost-inventory searches become rare.
Forecasts the labor hours needed for the next shift based on expected order volume and schedules warehouse staff against that forecast.
Gives end customers a live map of their courier's position on the final leg of delivery, with a countdown to estimated arrival.
Sends customers a text or push notification a set number of stops before their delivery, reducing missed-handoff rates for signature-required packages.
Captures a photo and signature at the doorstep and attaches both to the shipment record, closing out the delivery in the driver's app.
Lets one driver hand off a partially completed route to another mid-shift, transferring remaining stops and package scans without losing chain of custody.
Lets customers pick a preferred delivery time window at checkout and keeps the promised slot in sync with the driver's live route.
A marketplace board where shippers post loads and carriers accept them, matching available capacity to freight needing to move.
Lets carriers bid on spot freight in real time, giving shippers a competitive rate within minutes of posting a load.
Manages standing lane-rate contracts between shippers and carriers, auto-tendering loads to the contracted carrier before opening them to the spot market.
Generates an instant freight quote from origin, destination, and load details, pulling from historical lane pricing to set a fair rate.
Searches the carrier network for available trailers matching a load's equipment type and timing needs when a preferred carrier can't cover it.
The main driver-facing app for viewing today's assigned stops, navigating between them, and marking each delivery complete.
Walks drivers through a required pre-trip vehicle inspection checklist before dispatch clears them to leave the yard.
Tracks hours-of-service compliance automatically from the vehicle's engine data, warning drivers before they approach a duty-time limit.
Gives drivers a digital fuel card in-app with per-trip spending limits set by dispatch, replacing paper fuel authorization slips.
Lets a driver log an accident or cargo damage incident on the spot with photos and a guided questionnaire that routes straight to safety and claims.
Renders a 3D view of how cargo should be loaded into a trailer to maximize cube utilization while respecting stacking and weight rules.
Checks planned axle weights against legal limits before a truck leaves the dock, flagging loads that need to be repositioned.
Suggests how to combine multiple partial shipments into a single trailer to reduce the number of half-empty trucks leaving the yard.
Orders cargo inside a multi-stop trailer so items for the first drop-off are loaded last and accessible without unloading the whole truck.
Calculates the optimal pallet configuration for mixed-case orders so warehouse staff build pallets that ship without wasted trailer space.
Centralizes the customs paperwork required for cross-border shipments, letting brokers upload and track document status per shipment.
Looks up applicable duty rates and tariff classifications for a given product and destination country before a shipment crosses the border.
Suggests the correct harmonized system code for a product description, reducing misclassification errors on customs filings.
Keeps an immutable log of every customs filing and amendment for a shipment, used during regulatory audits and carrier disputes.
Provides a threaded messaging channel between shippers and customs brokers attached to each shipment record, replacing scattered email chains.
Shows yard jockeys a map of every trailer's current spot so they can find and move the right trailer without walking the whole lot.
Handles driver check-in at the gate, verifying appointment details and printing a yard pass before directing them to their assigned spot.
Automatically assigns an open yard spot to each arriving trailer based on which dock it's headed to next, reducing repositioning moves.
Tracks how long each trailer has sat in the yard against its free-time allowance, flagging trailers about to accrue detention charges.
Sequences which parked trailer moves to a dock door next based on appointment priority and dock availability.
Scores contracted carriers on on-time pickup, on-time delivery, and claims rate, giving procurement a scorecard for lane awards.
Verifies a new carrier's insurance, safety rating, and authority before they're approved to haul freight on the network.
Stores negotiated lane rates and accessorial charges per carrier, used to validate invoices against the agreed contract terms.
Translates EDI load tenders, status updates, and invoices between the company's systems and each carrier's own transportation management system.
Logs freight damage and loss claims against the responsible carrier and tracks resolution status through to reimbursement.
Stitches together scan events from every carrier and mode into one timeline so a shipment can be tracked from origin to final delivery.
Predicts likely delivery delays using live traffic, weather, and carrier performance data, giving planners early warning to notify customers.
Flags shipments that miss an expected scan event within a set window and routes the exception to the operations team for follow-up.
Gives shipper customers a self-service portal to look up the status of their own freight without calling customer service.
Publishes a webhook feed of shipment milestones, such as picked up, in transit, and delivered, for internal systems and partner integrations to subscribe to.
Lets carriers book a dock appointment window online, spreading arrivals evenly across the day to avoid yard congestion.
Lets an arriving carrier check themselves into their booked dock appointment from a kiosk, skipping the gate attendant during busy hours.
Calculates detention fees owed when a carrier exceeds the free loading or unloading time at a dock appointment and generates the invoice line.
Displays a live board of which trailer is at which dock door right now, used by warehouse supervisors to coordinate loading crews.
Models how many dock doors a facility needs during peak season based on projected appointment volume, helping ops plan temporary staffing.
